archive.title: Archive

new.title: Create event

editor.nextLifecycleTitle: Draft/rejected → submit for approval; ended → archive

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.bodyOutro: (not published until an admin approves). Cancel and archive use dedicated API routes; arbitrary status is not PATCHable from the organizer app.

concurrentTab.title: This event is open in another tab or window
concurrentTab.body: Another editor may have saved changes. Reload to see the latest server copy, or keep editing here — your unsaved fields stay on this screen until you save.

hints.ticketSales: When buyers can purchase tickets. Sales may start before the event. Set both dates for clarity.

placeholders.locationAutoSave: Location updates save automatically shortly after you pick a place or finish moving the pin.

media.uploadHint: Upload JPG, PNG, or WEBP images only. Maximum file size is 6 MB per image.

tickets.apiNote: Saved via POST/PATCH/DELETE …/ticket-types using canonical fields name, price, quantity_limit (≥1). Nested ticket_types on event PATCH is not supported by the API.
tickets.multiDayHint: One ticket covers full span (when applicable)
tickets.waitlist: Waitlist (demo): {{count}} users are waiting for ticket availability.

more.empty: No post-event content yet. Post-event media appears when the event is ended or archived.

validation.endsAfterStarts: End time must be after start time.
validation.salesBothRequired: Sales start and end dates must both be set.
validation.salesEndsAfterStarts: Sales end date must be after sales start date.
